name: Garware Marine Industries Limited
about: Garware Marine Industries Limited provides ship repair services in India. Its services comprise pump overhauls, engine overhaul/repairs, hydraulic and gear box repair, and pipeline and other marine fabrication jobs. The company also assists OEM engineers in propeller hub overhaul, shaft removal and renewal, stern thruster overhauls, major day dockings, and bow thruster. The company was formerly known as Modern Nets Limited and changed its name to Garware Marine Industries Limited in December 1981. Garware Marine Industries Limited was incorporated in 1975 and is based in Mumbai, India.
